description: Dependencies declared as constructor parameters; Angular resolves them from the parameter types.
`constructor(private readonly s: Service)` declares and assigns a class field in one step.
TypeScript option that stores constructor parameter types (`design:paramtypes`) at runtime, used by JIT-compiled Angular.
Decorator that makes a class field bindable from a parent template. Supports `required`, `alias` and `transform`.
Declares a custom event; the child calls `emit(value)` and the parent listens with `(event)="..."`.
Lifecycle hook receiving `SimpleChanges` (previous/current values) whenever decorator inputs change.
